description.p: LDM is a download manager for Linux, modelled on 1DM for Android. Downloads keep running in a background service, so closing the window never stops them.

ul.li: Splits files into parts and downloads them over several connections
Pauses, resumes and retries; expired links can be replaced without losing progress
Downloads videos and streams, including YouTube, HLS and DASH (via yt-dlp)
Downloads torrents and magnet links, with file selection and seeding limits
Runs scheduled downloads in a time window and can wait for an unmetered connection
Has a browser extension for Firefox, Chrome and Brave

description.p: First release: multi-part downloads, video and torrent support, scheduler, browser extension.
